nodes.description: Public mapping(string => address) storing proxyTarget and proxyOwner configuration.
Constructor taking _proxyTarget, sets proxyTarget and proxyOwner (msg.sender) in addressManager.
External function guarded by proxyCallIfNotOwner that updates addressManager["proxyTarget"].
External function guarded by proxyCallIfNotOwner that sets addressManager["proxyOwner"] to msg.sender.
Internal function performing delegatecall to addressManager["proxyTarget"] with msg.data and returning/reverting using assembly.
Payable fallback that forwards every call to _doProxyCall, i.e. a delegatecall proxy.
Caller address used for ownership assignment and modifier authorization checks.
delegatecall to a user-configurable target executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
Local variables success and returndata holding the result of the delegatecall.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _proxyTarget exists only to initialize addressManager inside the constructor and has no independent semantics.
Parameter _proxyTarget is only used to overwrite addressManager["proxyTarget"] within setTargetContract.
